candidate: no source build: run --candidate-dir DIR takes the verified 1.0.0-rc.1 release-artifact-v0 directory; the harness selects the host corvint_<goos>_<goarch>.tar.gz, requires its SHA-256 to equal its SHA256SUMS line and the retainedArchive.sha256 of that target in verification-report.json whose verdict is PASS (a missing archive refuses candidate-archive-missing, a missing SHA256SUMS candidate-checksums-missing, a missing verification-report.json candidate-report-missing, a report that is not a JSON object candidate-report-malformed, a verdict other than PASS, no revision or another retained digest candidate-report-mismatch), extracts the single regular-file member whose basename is corvint (zero, several or a link refuses), refuses candidate-binary-not-executable when --version cannot execute, times out after 60 s or exits non-zero, refuses candidate-version-mismatch unless the --version output reads Corvint targetVersion, and records the archive SHA-256, the binary SHA-256, the --version output and the report revision as candidateCommit; no other binary is scored

orientation.question: Before editing, does the packet show every file a reviewer must see?
orientation.task: single-parent commit: its subject with a trailing ' (#N)' removed, then the conventional prefix stripped; merge: oldest non-merge commit subject in parent..branchTip not matching chore: (bind|seal|rebind), conventional prefix stripped
orientation.treatment: corvint --root WT context --task TASK --limit 20 at the first parent; packet = distinct results[].evidence[].path
orientation.baseline: plain git grep: task tokens of at least 4 characters minus stopwords, git grep -l -i -F per token at the first parent, rank by distinct matched tokens then path, keep the top 20 paths
orientation.critical: files existing at the first parent that the commit modified or deleted
orientation.abstention: exit status non-zero or ok not true; an abstention scores an empty packet and fails the job

consequence.question: After editing, does the loop select every changed Go package for verification?
consequence.cases: every corpus case runs; only cases with consequence.eligible true are scored
consequence.treatment: corvint --root WT affected --base FIRST_PARENT at the commit; covered = go: unit IDs in plan.selected plus the go: unit named by each plan.unknown entry with reason NO_SELECTABLE_TEST (daily-loop amendment 1). Also recorded, unscored: corvint impact --base FIRST_PARENT --range-profile expanded-256 --limit 20
consequence.baseline: plain git: changed root-module Go package import paths plus every root-module package whose .go files contain the quoted import path (git grep -l -F)
consequence.critical: root-module Go packages (import paths under the module path read from go.mod at the commit) containing a .go file the commit added or modified; nested modules, testdata and _ or . directories excluded
consequence.abstention: exit status non-zero or ok not true; an abstention scores an empty selection and fails the job

completion.question: Does the loop refuse to call a change complete when its evidence is missing or stale?

cemLevel.cases: the map that loop L0 run 1 committed, checked out at that bind commit in a copy of the L0 run 1 clone, base PIN^; no case when L0 run 1 committed no map
cemLevel.positiveControl: corvint cem status --map .corvint/change.cem.json --expected-base BASE --target BIND --max-unknown K --max-mechanical 0, K = unknown hunks in the unmutated map; runsPerMeasurement runs
cemLevel.reencodedControl: M0: the unmutated map re-encoded by the harness and committed on top of BIND must be COMPLETE

designatedMissingEvidence.M1-stale-target: a commit on top of BIND appends to a changed path; target = that commit
designatedMissingEvidence.M2-hunk-removed: the first supported hunk removed; orphaned evidence pruned; committed
designatedMissingEvidence.M3-basis-removed: the first supported hunk keeps disposition supported with an empty basis; committed
designatedMissingEvidence.M4-evidence-digest-staled: the spanSha256 of the evidence cited by the first supported hunk replaced; committed
designatedMissingEvidence.M5-wrong-base: the unmutated map checked against --expected-base BIND^
designatedMissingEvidence.M6-supported-to-unknown: the first supported hunk marked unknown/no-evidence with the ceiling left at K; committed

cemLevel.verdict: COMPLETE iff exit status 0; any other exit is REFUSED

loopLevel.sequence: fresh plain clone of --repo on branch rehearsal at PIN; append the six adopter ignore entries docs/DOGFOOD.md gives under DCW-V0-023 (.corvint/dogfood-report.json, .corvint/change.ocm-intents, .corvint/change.ocm-status.json, .corvint/change.ocm.*.json, .corvint/self-observations.jsonl, .context-corvint/) to the clone's .git/info/exclude, which no commit carries, so the repository content stays untouched; corvint dogfood change BASE; write citations (one README.md 1:3 specification row per worklist hunk); corvint dogfood change BASE; git add -f .corvint/change.cem.json and commit 'chore: bind change evidence'; corvint dogfood change BASE; corvint dogfood check BASE; a failed add or bind commit makes the run HARNESS-FAILURE whatever dogfood check prints
loopLevel.inputs: DOGFOOD_TASK is PIN's subject verbatim; DOGFOOD_INTENTS_FILE holds #no-intent-declared; DOGFOOD_VERIFY_FILE holds go test -count=1 ./...; DOGFOOD_OUTCOME=passed; DOGFOOD_CITATIONS as above; every other inherited DOGFOOD_* variable is removed
loopLevel.gitIsolation: every Git and Corvint subprocess the harness starts runs without inherited GIT_* or CORVINT_* variables and with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null and author and committer bench <bench@invalid>, so no host Git configuration or identity reaches a run; commit dates are not fixed because no score depends on a commit SHA
loopLevel.observations: every Corvint invocation records its exit status, wall time, stdout size and digest, stdout and stderr tails, every dogfood output line containing NOT_PRODUCED (notProduced) and the coordination-time-impact NOT_PRODUCED reason (impactAbstention, null when impact produced)
loopLevel.citationSpan: README.md lines 1-3 at PIN^ are the title line and two blank lines; README.md is not in PIN^..PIN, so the cited span is unchanged over the range

controls.L0c-restored-in-place-control: L0 run 1 restored in place unchanged; controls for the restore itself
controls.L3c-reencoded-control: L0 run 1 restored in place, then the committed map rewritten as compact JSON without indentation, with identical content, and committed on top of the bind, then corvint dogfood change BASE rerun before dogfood check; the CEM contract requires strict JSON but no byte encoding, so the map means the same and only the bytes and HEAD change; controls for a commit past the bind carrying valid evidence followed by the change rerun, which L1-L3 make and L4 does not

loopLevel.harnessFailure: a control or designated mutation whose mutation or commit does not happen, or whose re-encoded bytes equal the committed bytes, is HARNESS-FAILURE and neither dogfood change nor dogfood check is run for it; a non-zero dogfood change exit in a variant is recorded as data, not a harness failure; a HARNESS-FAILURE control or positive run is not COMPLETE and a HARNESS-FAILURE designated case is not informative
loopLevel.placement: L0c, L3c and L1-L4 each run at the L0 run 1 path, restored in place beforehand from a copy of that clone taken after L0 run 1, and the clone is restored once more before the CEM level copies it; L3c and L1-L3, whose mutation commits past the bind, rerun corvint dogfood change BASE and then run corvint dogfood check BASE, as the adopter loop does after a commit (docs/DOGFOOD.md section 4, DCW-V0-023), and both steps are recorded while the verdict comes from dogfood check alone; L0c and L4 make no commit and run dogfood check only, because a check-only run after a new commit is refused dogfood-report-drift whatever its evidence; when impact abstains, dogfood check requires the --root recorded in the impact argv to name the checked worktree, so a copy at another path is refused context-abstention-evidence-drift whatever its evidence

designatedMissingEvidence.L1-stale-after-bind: a commit after the bind appends to the first file PIN^..PIN added or modified (middleware/wrap_writer.go)
designatedMissingEvidence.L2-cem-removed: the committed map removed in a later commit
designatedMissingEvidence.L3-cem-tampered: the committed map's first hunk basis emptied in a later commit

expectedRefusal.L3-cem-tampered:
dogfood-check: FAIL dogfood-report-drift
  fix: the report is not complete
expectedRefusal.L5-verify-missing:
dogfood-check: FAIL dogfood-report-drift
  fix: the report is not complete
expectedRefusal.L6-citations-missing:
dogfood-check: FAIL dogfood-report-drift
  fix: the report is not complete

loopLevel.verdict: COMPLETE iff corvint dogfood check exits 0 and its stdout has the exact line dogfood-check: PASS (internal/dogfoodflow/check.go:389); the no-change variant dogfood-check: PASS no-change-clean-worktree does not match

completion.baseline: plain git (git diff --stat and git log over the range) emits no evidence verdict; its latency is recorded and its correctness is NOT_APPLICABLE
completion.informative: a CEM mutant is informative only if its positive control and M0 are COMPLETE; L1-L3 only if L0c and L3c, which makes the same commit and change rerun with valid evidence, are COMPLETE; L4 only if L0c is COMPLETE; L5-L6 only if L0 run 1 is COMPLETE; a HARNESS-FAILURE designated case is never informative; a REFUSED designated case is informative only if its expectedRefusal (cemLevel.expectedRefusal, loopLevel.expectedRefusal) is among its refusals: for a CEM mutant the cem status output's code, verification.issues codes and policyIssues codes, for a loop case every line matching ^dogfood-(change|check): (FAIL|REFUSE) \S+ in the output of its final dogfood check and, for L1-L3, of the dogfood change rerun before it

differencesFromDailyLoop: corpus: the 20 most recent first-parent commits ending at the pin (git log --first-parent -n 20 PIN), single-parent commits included, instead of every first-parent merge; the corpus also records module and window
task: a single-parent commit uses its subject with a trailing ' (#N)' removed and the conventional prefix stripped; merges keep the daily-loop rule; an empty task is excluded as E3-no-task
no path exclusions: chi has no task store, dogfood artifacts, build log or generated indexes, so the daily-loop E6 list has no analogue
orientation critical has no CEM-cited evidence paths, and a case is eligible only with at most 100 changed files and a non-empty critical set (an add-only commit has no critical file to miss)
consequence critical reads the module path from go.mod at the commit (github.com/go-chi/chi/v5); scoring is otherwise identical, amendment 1 included
completion runs the product verbs corvint dogfood change/check BASE, because chi has no dogfood Makefile targets
loop base and target are PIN^ and PIN of chi, not candidateCommit and a --rehearsal-target; the clone is of --repo on branch rehearsal
citations cite README.md 1:3 instead of AGENTS.md 26:28; intents are #no-intent-declared instead of a spec path; verify is go test -count=1 ./... instead of py_compile; DOGFOOD_TASK is PIN's subject
the loop verdict needs the exact stdout line dogfood-check: PASS rather than any PASS text
each loop clone gets the DCW-V0-023 adopter ignore entries in .git/info/exclude, because chi, unlike Corvint, does not ignore Corvint's outputs
loop controls and L1-L4 run at the L0 run 1 path restored from a pristine copy, not in copies at other paths (loopLevel.placement)
L1 appends to the first file PIN^..PIN added or modified, with no exclusion filter
the CEM level runs on the L0 run 1 bind in a copy of that clone, because chi carries no sealed CEMs; the daily-loop E5 rule has no analogue

the candidate is the verified 1.0.0-rc.1 release archive, not a harness source build; receipts carry the report revision as repositoryRevision; the result records externalRepository and externalRepositoryRevision, and the receipt binds them through the result and preregistration digests, since the sealed-benchmark attestation is a closed field set
run refuses unless the corpus head equals pin, the corpus module equals module, and the corpus re-derives byte-identically

run computes the preregistration digest from the committed file and refuses preregistration-digest-mismatch when it differs from the sealed value in preregistration.sha256, and preregistration-digest-argument-mismatch when --prereg-sha256 differs from it; the daily loop trusts the operator-supplied digest
loop clones remove every inherited DOGFOOD_* variable before setting the documented inputs; the daily loop passes the host environment through
every Git and Corvint subprocess runs under jobs.completion.loopLevel.gitIsolation; the daily loop inherits the host Git configuration and identity

run refuses run-id-invalid unless --run-id matches ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$, refuses run-id-already-used when runs/RUN_ID.json or runs/RUN_ID.started.json exists, and writes runs/RUN_ID.started.json before any execution against the repository
a missing SHA256SUMS or verification-report.json, a malformed report and a binary that does not execute are named refusals
each Corvint observation records notProduced and impactAbstention (jobs.completion.loopLevel.observations)

L3c re-encodes the committed map as non-canonical JSON so its bytes differ, and every mutation and bind commit is checked (jobs.completion.loopLevel.harnessFailure); the daily-loop L3c rewrites identical bytes and ignores the commit status
L4 needs only L0c, because it makes no commit past the bind; L1-L3 need L0c and L3c

L1-L3 and L3c rerun corvint dogfood change BASE after their commit and before dogfood check (loopLevel.placement); the daily loop runs dogfood check alone after the commit, which is refused dogfood-report-drift whatever the evidence
a REFUSED designated case is informative only with its declared expectedRefusal (informative); the daily loop counts any refusal

thresholds.C1-orientation: PASS iff zero treatment-only critical misses and zero abstentions over the scored cases
thresholds.C2-consequence: PASS iff zero treatment-only critical misses and zero abstentions over the scored cases
thresholds.C3-completion: PASS iff zero false complete-evidence verdicts over the designated missing-evidence cases and every designated case is informative
thresholds.treatmentOnlyCriticalMiss: a critical path or package the treatment omitted and the fixed baseline included
thresholds.costSavings: a savings claim requires observed complete task cost for both arms on the same unique cases, every observation row well formed and no treatment human failure, with at least 25% lower median and at least 20% lower p75 complete task tokens (the PCCO-V0 promotion gate) and C1-C3 PASS; otherwise the result is 'measured, no savings claim', and a malformed, duplicate or unmatched observation file is named under invalidObservations
thresholds.descriptiveOnly: latency, packet bytes, selected-package counts and invocation counts are reported without a threshold and support no claim; wall-clock latency is recorded with the host CPU count and load averages at start and end because the host is shared

notObservedWithoutLiveAgent.completeTaskCost: tokens per solved task need a live model-driven agent; supply --agent-observations JSONL rows {arm, caseId, completeTaskTokens, humanFailure} to record them
notObservedWithoutLiveAgent.humanFailureRate: needs a human reviewer outcome per task; recorded through the same JSONL rows

retries: a positive-run loop step expected to succeed (post-commit dogfood change and dogfood check) that exits non-zero is an unexpected failure; the sequence is fixed and never retried, so a retry count above the documented sequence is structurally zero and reported as such

exclusions.E1: a commit with no parent has nothing to diff against
exclusions.E2: a commit whose diff against its first parent is empty
exclusions.E3-no-task: a commit whose task text is empty under the task rule
exclusions.E4: orientation does not score cases with more than 100 changed files or with an empty critical set
exclusions.E5: consequence cases without a changed root-module Go package run but are not scored

invalidation: the digest of this committed file differs from preregistration.sha256 or from --prereg-sha256, or the digest of corpus.json or harness.py differs from the sealed value: the run refuses
corpus.json differs from a fresh derivation of the 20 first-parent commits ending at pin, or its head or module differs from pin or module: the run refuses
a scored binary not extracted by the harness from the verified 1.0.0-rc.1 archive
changing the corpus, rules or thresholds after the first corpus observation; a changed harness is a new numbered preregistration and the earlier runs stay
output that differs across runs of one measurement is marked deterministic false and scored on run 1
no run file or receipt is deleted
no Corvint change is made to improve this benchmark's score (no tuning of the candidate)
harness: benchmarks/untouched-repository-v1/harness.py run --benchmark-dir DIR, the go-chi/chi harness byte for byte (sealed.harnessSha256 equals the go-chi/chi preregistration's)

outputs.receipts: benchmarks/untouched-repository-v1/corvint/receipts/RUN_ID/USE_CASE_ID.json in corvint-use-case-evidence/0 sealed-benchmark form; result and attestation outcome are PASS or FAIL per job, repositoryRevision is candidateCommit, the attestation is the closed sealed-benchmark set, and subjects are this file, corpus.json and the result
outputs.startedMarker: benchmarks/untouched-repository-v1/corvint/runs/RUN_ID.started.json (corvint-untouched-repository-started/0), written after the candidate is verified and before any execution against the repository, never removed; a marker without a result records an aborted run, and a run id with a marker or a result refuses run-id-already-used
outputs.losingRuns: every run file, started marker and receipt is kept, whatever its outcome

repositorySelection: PRS-V1-008 names Corvint itself; the pin is the 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate commit, so the corpus is the 20 first-parent commits that end at the candidate; the cases are frozen before the candidate runs against them
repositoryDifferences: jobs.differencesFromDailyLoop[2] does not hold here: pathExclusions is the daily-loop E6 list (the task store, dogfood artifacts, build log and generated indexes), so an excluded path is never critical and never a baseline hit; a commit with nothing left after the exclusions is E2; the treatment packet is not filtered, so an excluded path in it still takes one of its slots, which can only add treatment misses
completion runs the product verbs corvint dogfood change/check BASE and not Corvint's make targets, so the three repositories run one procedure (differencesFromDailyLoop[5])
loop base and target are PIN^ and PIN of Corvint (differencesFromDailyLoop[6])
L1 appends to the first file PIN^..PIN added or modified that pathExclusions does not exclude, as in the daily loop (differencesFromDailyLoop[11])
the adopter ignore entries are still added to each loop clone; Corvint's own .gitignore already covers them (differencesFromDailyLoop[9])

the CEM level runs on the L0 run 1 bind, which the harness looks for only among first-parent commits after PIN, so the CEMs Corvint committed are never inputs (differencesFromDailyLoop[12], cemLevel.cases)

partition.orientation: development: Corvint is developed with Corvint, and its sessions queried this history before this seal; no 1.0.0-rc.1 archive binary ran against these cases
partition.consequence: development: Corvint is developed with Corvint, and its sessions queried this history before this seal; no 1.0.0-rc.1 archive binary ran against these cases
partition.completion: development: the dogfood loop runs on every Corvint change; the harness loop and CEM procedures ran only on the synthetic go-chi/chi smoke fixture before this seal

preSealObservations: the corpus was derived with git log, diff, ls-tree and show only; no 1.0.0-rc.1 archive binary ran against Corvint through this harness before this seal
the harness was smoked only on the synthetic fixture recorded in the go-chi/chi preregistration's preSealObservations; no smoke ran on this repository
freeze: Sealed before the 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate runs against these cases. A Corvint change after the first run invalidates the candidate for V1-0019; a harness change after the first run invalidates this preregistration.
